data.name: Dharamveer
data.gender_notes: Dharamveer is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who upholds and embodies righteousness and courage. In Hindu mythology, Dharamveer is a name given to brave and just rulers, warriors, and heroes. It is a name that signifies strength, wisdom, and a strong moral compass. The name Dharamveer carries the meaning “Dharma (Duty, Righteousness) + Veer (Hero, Brave)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dharamveer usually hope their child will grow to embody dharma (duty, righteousness) + veer (hero, brave) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies one's commitment to Dharma and the courage to uphold it, even in the face of adversity
data.etymology: Dharamveer belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dharma (Duty, Righteousness) + Veer (Hero, Brave).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dharamveer total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: Dharamveer is a name that holds deep cultural significance in Hindu tradition. In many Indian societies and communities, the name is synonymous with strength, courage, and righteousness. The name holds high regard for individuals who possess these qualities, especially for those in leadership positions, such as warriors or rulers. It is a name that inspires respect and admiration, and it resonates with the idea of protecting and upholding the values and traditions of Hindu culture.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Dharamveer represents the ideal embodiment of dharma - the Hindu concept of righteousness, order, and duty. The name suggests a deep sense of inner moral compass, which guides one to act with courage, wisdom, and integrity, even in the face of adversity. It is a name that resonates with the spiritual ideals of righteousness, truth, and selflessness and encourages individuals to embody these qualities in all aspects of their lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Dharamveer: One who upholds righteousness and is a brave warrior in the battlefield of life, adhering to moral virtues and principles.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Dharamveer was a legendary warrior in the Hindu epic Mahabharata. The name Dharamveer carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Dharamveer was a great warrior and a devotee of Lord Krishna. He was a member of the Pandava army and fought in the great battle of Kurukshetra against the Kauravas.
